index 138f330..1c773f0 100755
--- a/debian/hwe-helper/apt_hook_ubuntu_virt
+++ b/debian/hwe-helper/apt_hook_ubuntu_virt
@@ -143,8 +143,33 @@ def orphaned_removals(installs: list[str], removals: list[str]) -> list[str]:
                 result.append(pkg)
     return result
 
+def make_virt_sticky() -> None:
+    """Mark the ubuntu-virt[−hwe] package as manually installed.
+
+    Try ubuntu-virt first; on failure fall back to ubuntu-virt-hwe.
+    Any error is ignored so the apt transaction is never disrupted.
+    """
+    for pkg in ("ubuntu-virt", "ubuntu-virt-hwe"):
+        result = subprocess.run(
+            ["apt-mark", "manual", pkg],
+            capture_output=True,
+            text=True,
+            check=False,
+        )
+        if result.returncode == 0:
+            break
+
+def do_post_invoke() -> int:
+    """Handle the post-invoke phase of the apt hook."""
+    make_virt_sticky()
+    return 0
 
 def main() -> int:
+    # detect phase
+    phase = sys.argv[1] if len(sys.argv) > 1 else "pre-install-pkgs"
+    if phase == "post-invoke":
+        return do_post_invoke()
+
     content = _read_hook_input()
     installs, removals = _parse_v2_transactions(content)

@@ -0,0 +1,98 @@
+#!/usr/bin/env python3
+
+# Copyright: 2026 Hector CAO <hector.cao@canonical.com>
+# SPDX-License-Identifier: GPL-3.0-or-later
+
+# Test: verify APT does not silently switch the base stack to the -hwe stack.
+#
+# HWE is opt-in. The ubuntu-virt package is kept marked as manually installed
+# so that APT never removes the base virt stack (and pulls in the -hwe variant)
+# while trying to satisfy a dependency. For each third-party reverse-dependency
+# of the virt stack, this test installs the package, confirms ubuntu-virt is
+# marked manual, then removes libvirt-daemon-system and confirms the base stack
+# is kept and no -hwe counterpart got installed.
+
+import os
+import subprocess
+import sys
+
+sys.path.insert(0, os.path.dirname(os.path.abspath(__file__)))
+
+import hwe_lib
+from hwe_lib import (
+    exit_with_failure,
+    is_installed,
+    run_cmd,
+    step,
+    remove_all_virt_packages,
+    is_marked_manual,
+)
+
+# Third-party reverse-dependencies of the virt stack to exercise.
+_THIRD_PARTY_PACKAGES = ("uvtool-libvirt", "debvm", "sbuild-qemu")
+
+
+def run_scenario(package):
+    step(f"=== Test for consumer package: {package} ===")
+
+    # install the third-party reverse-dependency of the virt stack
+    run_cmd(
+        f"Removing {package}",
+        "apt-get", "remove", "-y", package,
+    )
+    if not run_cmd(
+        f"Installing {package}",
+        "apt-get", "install", "-y", package,
+    ):
+        exit_with_failure(f"failed to install {package}", f"after installing {package}")
+
+    # ubuntu-virt must stay marked manual so APT never switches to -hwe
+    step("Verifying ubuntu-virt is marked manual")
+    if not is_marked_manual("ubuntu-virt"):
+        exit_with_failure(
+            "ubuntu-virt is not marked manual",
+            f"after installing {package}",
+        )
+
+    # remove some virt packages
+    run_cmd(
+        "Removing libvirt-daemon-system",
+        "apt-get", "remove", "-y", "libvirt-daemon-system", "qemu-utils",
+    )
+
+    # no -hwe counterpart must be installed
+    step("Verifying ubuntu-virt is still installed")
+    if not is_installed("ubuntu-virt"):
+        exit_with_failure("ubuntu-virt is no longer installed")
+
+    step("Verifying ubuntu-virt-hwe is not installed")
+    if is_installed("ubuntu-virt-hwe"):
+        exit_with_failure(
+            "ubuntu-virt-hwe was unexpectedly installed (unwanted stack switch)"
+        )
+
+def test_apt():
+    # cleanup existing virt stack installation
+    remove_all_virt_packages()
+
+    for package in _THIRD_PARTY_PACKAGES:
+        run_scenario(package)
+
+def main():
+    hwe_lib.LOG_FILE = os.environ.get("LOG_FILE", "check-unwanted-stack-switch.log")
+    os.environ["DEBIAN_FRONTEND"] = "noninteractive"
+
+    open(hwe_lib.LOG_FILE, "w").close()
+
+    # apt update
+    if not run_cmd(
+        "Refreshing apt metadata",
+        "apt-get", "-o", "APT::Sandbox::User=root", "-y", "update",
+    ):
+        exit_with_failure("failed to refresh apt metadata", "after apt update")
+
+    test_apt()
+
+
+if __name__ == "__main__":
+    hwe_lib.run_main(main)
